測試樣品層級與替代原則Test sample level and substitution principles Test sample level and substitution principles

測試樣品層級與替代原則Test sample level and substitution principles

Cell單一電芯本標準的預設受試樣品
→
Cell block並聯電芯組可經製造商與客戶協議，替代單一電芯受試
→
Module／Pack模組／電池包不屬於 IEC 62660-3 的試驗樣品層級
預設樣品

第 6 章安全性試驗以 Cell（單一電芯）為預設受試樣品。

替代方式

經電芯製造商與客戶雙方協議，Cell block 可取代單一 Cell進行試驗；這是替代關係，不表示兩種樣品都必須重複執行。

Cell block 定義

由多顆電芯以並聯方式連接，可含保險絲或 PTC 等保護元件，但尚未裝入最終外殼、端子配置或電子控制裝置。

數量與報告

各試驗的樣品數量可由雙方協議決定；試驗報告應記載樣品數量及類型（Cell 或 Cell block）。

判讀項目CellCell block
是否為預設樣品是否，屬協議替代
是否需與另一層級重複測試不需要；除非客戶規格、驗證計畫或雙方協議另有要求。
試驗項目原則上均對應第 6 章相同安全性試驗；採 Cell block 時，應在試驗計畫中明定固定、配線、容量／電流基準及判定單位。
內部短路試驗方法本體直接針對單一電芯內部建立短路。若以 Cell block 代表受試層級，應明確指定其中哪一顆電芯接受內短路操作及如何判定整體結果。
Module／Pack不應將 Cell block 直接等同於 Module 或 Pack；更高層級需依對應系統／電池包標準另行評估。
採用 Cell block 前，試驗計畫至少應確認：並聯數量保護元件固定與配線額定容量與電流換算施力／量測位置合格判定對象

依據：IEC 62660-3:2022，3.2、4.1 與 6.1。

顯示英文原文

Test sample level and substitution principles

Default sample: The safety tests in Clause 6 are primarily specified for an individual cell.

Alternative sample: A cell block may be used in place of a single cell when agreed between the cell manufacturer and the customer. This is an alternative, not a requirement to test both sample levels.

Cell block: A group of cells connected in parallel, with or without protective devices, and not yet fitted with its final housing, terminal arrangement or electronic control device.

Reporting: The number and type of test samples (cell or cell block) shall be stated in the test report.

Implementation note: When a cell block is selected, the test plan should define the parallel configuration, protection devices, fixing and wiring, capacity/current basis, loading or measurement location, and the unit to which the acceptance criteria are applied. Internal short-circuit methods remain operations on an individual cell within the selected sample configuration.

3.1

BEV／電池電動車BEV / battery electric vehicle

BEV / battery electric vehicle

僅以牽引用電池作為車輛推進動力來源的電動車。
英文定義
Electric vehicle with only a traction battery as power source for vehicle propulsion.
3.2

電芯組cell block

cell block

由多顆電芯以並聯方式連接而成，可具有或不具有保護裝置（例如保險絲或正溫度係數電阻 PTC），且尚未裝入最終外殼、端子配置或電子控制裝置的電芯群組。
英文定義
Group of cells connected together in parallel configuration with or without protective devices (e.g. fuse or positive temperature coefficient resistor (PTC)) and not yet fitted with its final housing, terminal arrangement or electronic control device.
3.3

圓柱型電芯cylindrical cell

cylindrical cell

呈圓柱形，且整體高度大於或等於直徑的電芯。
英文定義
Cell with a cylindrical shape in which the overall height is equal to or greater than the diameter.

[SOURCE: IEC 60050-482:2004, 482-02-39]

3.6

HEV／混合動力電動車HEV / hybrid electric vehicle

HEV / hybrid electric vehicle

同時具有可充電式儲能系統及燃料動力源，以供車輛推進的車輛。
英文定義
Vehicle with both a rechargeable energy storage system and a fuelled power source for propulsion.
3.10

軟包電芯pouch cell

pouch cell

外形為各面呈矩形的平行六面體，並採用方形柔性積層膜外殼的電芯。
英文定義
Cell having the shape of a parallelepiped whose faces are rectangular and with a prismatic flexible laminate film case.
3.11

方形硬殼電芯prismatic cell

prismatic cell

外形為各面呈矩形的平行六面體，並採用方形硬質外殼的電芯。

[SOURCE: IEC 60050-482:2004, 482-02-38, modified]

英文定義
Cell having the shape of a parallelepiped whose faces are rectangular and with a prismatic hard case.

[SOURCE: IEC 60050-482:2004, 482-02-38, modified - The word “cell” has been added to the term, “qualifies a cell or a battery” has been replaced with “cell” in the definition, and “and with a prismatic hard case housing” has been added.]

3.15

二次鋰離子電芯secondary lithium-ion cell

secondary lithium-ion cell

其電能源自鋰離子在負極與正極之間嵌入／脫嵌反應的二次單電芯。

條目註 1：二次電芯是藉由化學能直接轉換而提供電能的製造單元。電芯由電極、電解質、容器、端子及（如有）隔離部件構成。電極可為單極式或雙極式；前者的集流體僅具有單一極性的活性物質，後者則具有正極與負極活性物質。電解質可為具離子導電性的液體、固體或其混合物。電芯設計為可進行電氣充電。

條目註 2：本文件單獨使用「電芯」一詞時，係指二次鋰離子電芯。

英文定義
Secondary single cell whose electrical energy is derived from the insertion/extraction reactions of lithium-ions between the negative electrode and the positive electrode.

Note 1 to entry: A secondary cell is a manufactured unit providing a source of electrical energy by direct conversion of chemical energy. The cell consists of electrodes, electrolyte, container, terminals and, if any, separators. The electrode can be monopolar or bipolar; the current collector of the former has active material of single polarity and the latter has positive and negative electrode active materials. The electrolyte includes an ionic conductive liquid or solid, or a mixture of them. The cell is designed to be charged electrically.

Note 2 to entry: Where the term “cell” is used alone in this document, it refers to a secondary lithium-ion cell.

3.4

爆炸explosion

explosion

電芯容器劇烈開啟，且其固體內容物被強制拋出的失效。
英文定義
Failure that occurs when a cell container opens violently and its solid contents are forcibly expelled.
3.5

起火fire

fire

電芯或電芯組持續產生火焰超過 1 s。

條目註 1：火花及電弧不視為火焰。

英文定義
Emission of flames from a cell or cell block for more than 1 s.

Note 1 to entry: Sparks and arcing are not considered as flames.

3.7

內部短路internal short-circuit

internal short-circuit

電芯內部正極與負極之間非預期的電氣連接。
英文定義
Unintentional electrical connection between the negative and positive electrodes inside a cell.
3.8

漏液leakage

leakage

液態電解液從電芯外殼、封口部及／或端子等部位可見地逸出；設計用途的洩壓口除外。
英文定義
Visible escape of liquid electrolyte from a part, except for a vent, such as the case, sealing part, and/or terminals of the cell.
3.14

破裂rupture

rupture

由內部或外部原因導致電芯容器外殼發生機械失效，使內容物暴露或溢出，但未發生材料拋出。
英文定義
Mechanical failure of a container case of a cell induced by an internal or external cause, resulting in exposure or spillage but not ejection of materials.
3.18

洩壓venting

venting

依設計方式釋放電芯內部過高壓力，以避免發生破裂或爆炸。
英文定義
Release of excessive internal pressure from a cell in a manner intended by design to preclude rupture or explosion.
3.9

標稱電壓nominal voltage

nominal voltage

用於標示或識別電芯電壓的適當近似值。

[SOURCE: IEC 60050-482:2004, 482-03-31, modified]

英文定義
Suitable approximate value of the voltage used to designate or identify a cell.

[SOURCE: IEC 60050-482:2004, 482-03-31, modified - Deletion of “a battery or an electrochemical system” at the end of the definition.]

rated capacity

Cn

在規定條件下測得，並由電芯製造商宣告的電芯容量值，單位為安培小時（Ah）。

4 試驗條件Test conditions4 Test conditions

4.1 一般要求 PDF 第 9 頁General

除非本文件另有規定，電芯應於室溫下進行試驗。本文件所稱室溫為 25 °C ± 2 K。

結果報告中應記載所使用量測儀器的詳細資訊。

經電芯製造商與客戶協議，可使用電芯組取代單顆電芯進行試驗。

對於插電式混合動力電動車（PHEV）用電芯，電芯製造商可選擇 BEV 或 HEV 的試驗條件。

註：試驗與量測可使用電芯製造商建議的治具。

顯示英文原文

4.1 General PDF p. 9

Unless otherwise stated in this document, cells shall be tested at room temperature. For the purposes of this document, room temperature is 25 °C ± 2 K.

The details of the instrumentation used shall be provided in any report of results.

Cell blocks can be tested as an alternative to cells in accordance with the agreement between the cell manufacturer and the customer.

Concerning the cell for plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEV), the cell manufacturer can select either the test condition of BEV application or of HEV application.

NOTE Test and measurement can be conducted in a fixture as recommended by the cell manufacturer.

4.2 量測儀器 PDF 第 9～10 頁Measuring instruments

4.2.1 量測裝置範圍

儀器應能量測電壓與電流。儀器量程及量測方法的選擇，應確保符合各試驗規定的準確度。

使用類比儀器時，讀值應落在刻度範圍的最後三分之一。

如能提供等同的準確度，亦可使用其他量測儀器。

4.2.2 電壓量測

所使用電壓計的電阻應至少為 1 MΩ/V。

4.2.3 電流量測

電流計、分流器及導線的整體組合，其準確度等級應為 0.5 級或更佳。

4.2.4 溫度量測

電芯溫度應使用表面溫度量測裝置量測，其刻度解析度與校正準確度應等同於 4.2.1 的要求。量測位置宜最能反映電芯或電芯組溫度；必要時可於其他適當位置增加量測點。

溫度量測示例見圖 1，並應遵循電芯製造商規定的溫度量測指示。

4.2.5 其他量測

其他數值可使用符合 4.3 要求的量測裝置進行量測。

顯示英文原文

4.2 Measuring instruments PDF pp. 9-10

4.2.1 Range of measuring devices

The instruments used shall enable the values of voltage and current to be measured. The range of these instruments and measuring methods shall be chosen so as to ensure the accuracy specified for each test.

For analogue instruments, this implies that the readings shall be taken in the last third of the graduated scale.

Any other measuring instruments may be used provided they give an equivalent accuracy.

4.2.2 Voltage measurement

The resistance of the voltmeters used shall be at least 1 MΩ/V.

4.2.3 Current measurement

The entire assembly of ammeter, shunt and leads shall be of an accuracy class of 0,5 or better.

4.2.4 Temperature measurements

The cell temperature shall be measured by use of a surface temperature measuring device capable of an equivalent scale definition and accuracy of calibration as specified in 4.2.1. The temperature should be measured at a location which most closely reflects the cell or cell block temperature. The temperature may be measured at additional appropriate locations, if necessary.

The examples for temperature measurement are shown in Figure 1. The instructions for temperature measurement specified by the cell manufacturer shall be followed.

4.2.5 Other measurements

Other values may be measured by use of a measuring device, provided it complies with 4.3.

4.3 容許差 PDF 第 10 頁Tolerance

控制值或量測值相對於規定值或實際值的整體準確度，應符合下列容許差：

  • 電壓：±0.1 %
  • 電流：±1 %
  • 溫度：±2 K
  • 時間：±0.1 %
  • 質量：±0.1 %
  • 尺寸：±0.1 %

上述容許差包含量測儀器準確度、量測技術及試驗程序中所有其他誤差來源的綜合影響。

顯示英文原文

4.3 Tolerance PDF p. 10

The overall accuracy of controlled or measured values, relative to the specified or actual values, shall be within the following tolerances:

  1. ±0,1 % for voltage;
  2. ±1 % for current;
  3. ±2 K for temperature;
  4. ±0,1 % for time;
  5. ±0,1 % for mass;
  6. ±0,1 % for dimensions.

These tolerances comprise the combined accuracy of the measuring instruments, the measurement technique used, and all other sources of error in the test procedure.

4.4 熱穩定 PDF 第 10 頁Thermal stabilization

為使電芯溫度穩定，電芯應在規定環境溫度下靜置至少 12 h。若已達熱穩定，可縮短此時間。

若相隔 1 h 的兩次量測中，電芯溫度變化小於 1 K，即視為已達熱穩定。

顯示英文原文

4.4 Thermal stabilization PDF p. 10

For the stabilization of cell temperature, the cell shall be soaked to a specified ambient temperature for a minimum of 12 h. This period may be reduced if thermal stabilization is reached. Thermal stabilization is considered to be reached if after one interval of 1 h, the change of cell temperature is lower than 1 K.

5 電氣量測與試驗前處理Electrical measurement5 Electrical measurement

5.1 一般充電條件 PDF 第 10～11 頁General charge conditions

除非本文件另有規定，進行電氣量測前，電芯應依下列方式充電。

充電前，電芯應在室溫下以定電流放電至電芯製造商規定的放電截止電壓：

  • BEV：1/3 It（A）
  • HEV：1 It（A）

完成放電後，應在室溫下依電芯製造商宣告的充電方法進行充電。

顯示英文原文

5.1 General charge conditions PDF pp. 10-11

Unless otherwise stated in this document, prior to the electrical measurement, the cell shall be charged as follows.

Prior to charging, the cell shall be discharged at room temperature at a constant current of 1/3 It (A) for BEV application and 1 It (A) for HEV application down to an end-of-discharge voltage specified by the cell manufacturer. Then, the cell shall be charged at room temperature according to the charging method declared by the cell manufacturer.

5.2 容量確認 PDF 第 11 頁Capacity

進行 5.3 的 SOC 調整前，應依下列階段確認試驗電芯容量符合額定值：

  1. 階段 1：依 5.1 充電；充電後依 4.4 使電芯溫度穩定。
  2. 階段 2：在室溫下以定電流放電至製造商規定的放電截止電壓：BEV 為 1/3 It；HEV 為 1 It。
  3. 階段 3：量測到達規定放電截止電壓的放電時間，並計算以 Ah 表示的電芯容量，取三位有效數字。
顯示英文原文

5.2 Capacity PDF p. 11

Before the SOC adjustment in 5.3, the capacity of the test cell shall be confirmed to be the rated value in accordance with the following phases.

  1. Phase 1 - The cell shall be charged in accordance with 5.1. After charge, the cell temperature shall be stabilized in accordance with 4.4.
  2. Phase 2 - The cell shall be discharged at room temperature at a constant current of 1/3 It (A) for BEV application and at 1 It (A) for HEV application to the end-of-discharge voltage that is specified by the cell manufacturer.
  3. Phase 3 - Measure the discharge duration until the specified end-of-discharge voltage is reached, and calculate the capacity of the cell expressed in Ah up to three significant figures.

5.3 SOC 調整 PDF 第 11 頁SOC adjustment

SOC 調整用於將試驗電芯準備至各項試驗要求的 SOC，程序如下：

  1. 階段 1：依 5.1 對電芯充電。
  2. 階段 2：依 4.4 在室溫下靜置電芯。
  3. 階段 3：以定電流放電至目標 SOC：
    • BEV：以 1/3 It（A）放電 (100 − n) / 100 × 3 h
    • HEV：以 1 It（A）放電 (100 − n) / 100 × 1 h
    其中 n 為各試驗欲調整的 SOC（%）。
顯示英文原文

5.3 SOC adjustment PDF p. 11

The test cells shall be charged as specified in the following list. The SOC adjustment is the procedure to be followed for preparing cells to the various SOCs for the tests in this document.

  1. Phase 1 - The cell shall be charged in accordance with 5.1.
  2. Phase 2 - The cell shall be left at rest at room temperature in accordance with 4.4.
  3. Phase 3 - The cell shall be discharged at a constant current of 1/3 It (A) for BEV application and of 1 It (A) for HEV application for (100 - n)/100 × 3 h for BEV application and (100 - n)/100 × 1 h for HEV application, where n is SOC (%) to be adjusted for each test.

6 安全性試驗Safety tests6 Safety tests

6.1 一般要求 PDF 第 11 頁General

  • 第 6 章所有試驗均應在報告中記載試驗配置，包括電芯固定與配線方式。
  • 必要時，為避免電芯變形，可在不違反試驗目的的前提下於試驗期間支撐或固定電芯。
  • 試驗電芯的製造時間不得超過 6 個月。
  • 各試驗的電芯數量可由電芯製造商與客戶協議決定；經雙方協議，亦可使用電芯組取代單顆電芯。
  • 試驗報告應記載樣品數量與類型（電芯或電芯組）。
  • 除非另有規定，各試驗結束後均應進行 1 h 觀察。
安全警告：本章試驗程序若未採取適當防護，可能造成人員傷害。僅限具資格與經驗的人員在適當防護下執行。試驗可能使電芯外殼溫度超過 75 °C，應採取措施避免燙傷。
顯示英文原文

6.1 General PDF p. 11

For all the tests specified in this Clause 6, the test installation shall be reported, including the method used for fixing and wiring of the cell. If necessary, to prevent deformation, the cell may be maintained during the test in a manner that complies with the test purpose.

The tests shall be performed on cells that are not more than six months old. The number of cells under each test can be determined according to the agreement between the cell manufacturer and the customer. A cell block may be used for testing in place of a single cell in accordance with the agreement between the cell manufacturer and the customer.

The number and type of test samples (cell or cell block) shall be provided in a test report.

Each test shall end with the one-hour observation period, unless otherwise specified in this document.

Warning: THE TESTS USE PROCEDURES WHICH MAY RESULT IN HARM IF ADEQUATE PRECAUTIONS ARE NOT TAKEN. TESTS SHOULD ONLY BE PERFORMED BY QUALIFIED AND EXPERIENCED TECHNICIANS USING ADEQUATE PROTECTION. TO PREVENT BURNS, CAUTION SHOULD BE TAKEN FOR THOSE CELLS WHOSE CASES MAY EXCEED 75 °C AS A RESULT OF TESTING.

6.2 機械試驗

6.2.1 機械衝擊 IEC 62660-3：PDF 第 12 頁｜IEC 62660-2：第 12 頁Mechanical shock

試驗目的

模擬車輛正常運行期間電芯可能承受的機械衝擊，並驗證該條件下的安全性能。

引用方法來源

IEC 62660-3:2022 的 6.2.1.2 規定，本試驗應依 IEC 62660-2:2018 的 6.2.2.2 執行；以下已整合該引用條款的完整試驗條件。

試驗前提
  • BEV：依 5.3 將 SOC 調整至 100 %。
  • HEV：依 5.3 將 SOC 調整至 80 %。
試驗方向
  • 依 ISO 16750-3 執行，試驗衝擊加速度方向應與車輛使用時可能發生的衝擊加速度方向一致。
  • 若無法確認實際作用方向，應對電芯的 六個空間方向全部進行試驗。
機械衝擊參數
IEC 62660-2:2018 表 3－機械衝擊試驗參數
脈衝波形半正弦波
加速度500 m/s²
持續時間6 ms
衝擊次數每一試驗方向 10 次
量測與記錄
  • 試驗前後的電芯電壓與容量；
  • 試驗結束時的電芯狀態，依 IEC 62660-2:2018 第 7 章的狀態描述記錄。
合格判定

依 IEC 62660-3:2022 的 6.2.1.3，試驗期間不得出現漏液、洩壓、破裂、起火或爆炸。

顯示英文原文

6.2 Mechanical tests

6.2.1 Mechanical shock PDF p. 12

6.2.1.1 Purpose

This test is performed to simulate mechanical shocks to a cell that may occur during the normal operation of the vehicle, and to verify the safety performance of the cell under such conditions.

6.2.1.2 Test

The test shall be performed in accordance with 6.2.2.2 of IEC 62660-2:2018.

6.2.1.3 Acceptance criteria

During the test, the cell shall exhibit no evidence of leakage, venting, rupture, fire or explosion.

Integrated reference — IEC 62660-2:2018, 6.2.2 Mechanical shock

6.2.2.1 Purpose

This test is performed to characterize cell responses to mechanical shocks assumed in the use of a vehicle.

6.2.2.2 Test

The test shall be performed as follows.

  1. Adjust the SOC of the cell to 100 % for BEV application and to 80 % for HEV application in accordance with 5.3.
  2. Perform the test in accordance with ISO 16750-3 as shown in Table 3. Acceleration from the shock in the test shall be applied in the same direction as the acceleration of the shock that occurs in the vehicle. If the direction of the effect is not known, the cell shall be tested in all six spatial directions.
Table 3 — Mechanical shock test — parameters
Pulse shapehalf-sinusoidal
Acceleration500 m/s²
Duration6 ms
Number of shocks10 per test direction
6.2.2.3 Test results

The following shall be measured and recorded as test results:

  • cell voltage and capacity before and after the test;
  • condition of the cell at the end of the test in accordance with the description specified in Clause 7.

6.2.2 擠壓 PDF 第 12～13 頁Crush

試驗目的

模擬可能使電芯變形的外部載荷，並驗證該條件下的安全性能。

試驗前提
  • BEV：SOC 調整至 100 %。
  • HEV：SOC 調整至 80 %。
試驗配置與施力
  • 將電芯置於絕緣、剛性且平坦的支撐面。
  • 擠壓工具應為實心材料，可採圓棒、半圓棒，或直徑 150 mm 的球體／半球體。
  • 施力方向應近似垂直於電芯內正、負極層疊面的較大側面，並作用於電芯約略中心位置。
  • 擠壓速度應 ≤ 6 mm/min。
停止條件

下列任一條件先發生時，應解除施力：

  • 電芯電壓相較原始值突降三分之一；
  • 相較初始尺寸的變形量達 15 % 以上；
  • 施力達電芯重量的 1 000 倍。
觀察

觀察 24 h，或直到電芯溫度已下降最大溫升的 80 %，兩者取較早發生者。

工具選擇註記

圓棒可用於圓柱型電芯；球體可用於方形硬殼或軟包電芯。

合格判定

試驗期間不得出現起火或爆炸。

顯示英文原文

6.2.2 Crush PDF pp. 12-13

6.2.2.1 Purpose

This test is performed to simulate external load forces that may cause deformation of a cell, and to verify the safety performance of the cell under such conditions.

6.2.2.2 Test

The test shall be performed as follows:

  1. Adjust the SOC of cell to 100 % for BEV application and to 80 % for HEV application in accordance with 5.3;
  2. The cell shall be placed on an insulated rigid flat supporting surface, and a force shall be applied to it with a crushing tool made of a solid material in the shape of a round or semicircular bar, or in the shape of a sphere or hemisphere with a 150 mm diameter. The force for the crushing shall be applied in a direction nearly perpendicular to a larger side of the layered face of the positive and negative electrodes inside the cell. The force shall be applied to the approximate centre of the cell as shown in Figure 2. The crush speed shall be less than or equal to 6 mm/min;
  3. The force shall be released when an abrupt voltage drop of one-third of the original cell voltage occurs, or a deformation of 15 % or more of the initial cell dimension occurs, or a force of 1 000 times the weight of the cell is applied, whichever comes first. The cells shall be under observation for 24 h or until the cell temperature declines by 80 % of the maximum temperature rise, whichever occurs sooner.

NOTE The round bar can be used to crush a cylindrical cell, and the sphere can be used to crush a prismatic cell or pouch cell.

6.2.2.3 Acceptance criteria

During the test, the cell shall exhibit no evidence of fire or explosion.

6.3 熱試驗

6.3.1 高溫耐受 PDF 第 13 頁High temperature endurance

試驗目的

模擬車輛在可合理預見的誤用或事故中，電芯可能遭遇的高溫環境，並驗證安全性能。

試驗前提
  • BEV：SOC 100 %。
  • HEV：SOC 80 %。
試驗條件
  1. 將已在室溫穩定的電芯置於自然對流或循環風烘箱。
  2. 以 5 K/min 升溫至 130 °C ± 2 K。
  3. 於該溫度保持 30 min。
  4. 關閉加熱器後，電芯留在烘箱內觀察 1 h。
合格判定

試驗期間不得出現起火或爆炸。

顯示英文原文

6.3 Thermal test

6.3.1 High temperature endurance PDF p. 13

6.3.1.1 Purpose

This test is performed to simulate a high-temperature environment that the cell may experience during the reasonably foreseeable misuse or incident of the vehicle, and to verify the safety performance of the cell under such conditions.

6.3.1.2 Test

The test shall be performed as follows:

  1. Adjust the SOC of the cell to 100 % for BEV applications, and to 80 % for HEV applications in accordance with 5.3;
  2. The cell, stabilized at room temperature, shall be placed in a gravity or circulating air convection oven. The oven temperature shall be raised at a rate of 5 K/min to 130 °C ± 2 K. The cell shall remain at this temperature for 30 min. Then, after the heater is turned off, the cell shall be observed for 1 h in the oven.
6.3.1.3 Acceptance criteria

During the test, the cell shall exhibit no evidence of fire or explosion.

6.3.2 溫度循環 IEC 62660-3：PDF 第 13～14 頁｜IEC 62660-2：第 14～15 頁Temperature cycling

試驗目的

交替暴露於低溫與高溫環境，使電芯部件產生膨脹與收縮，以模擬預期的環境溫度變化並驗證電芯的熱耐久性及安全性能。

引用方法來源

IEC 62660-3:2022 的 6.3.2.2 規定，本試驗應依 IEC 62660-2:2018 的 6.3.2.2 執行；以下已整合該引用條款的完整試驗條件。

試驗前提
  • BEV：依 5.3 將 SOC 調整至 100 %。
  • HEV：依 5.3 將 SOC 調整至 80 %。
溫度邊界與循環次數
  • 依 ISO 16750-4 及下表執行溫度循環。
  • 最低操作溫度：−40 °C，或採電芯製造商規定的 Tmin。
  • 最高操作溫度：85 °C，或採電芯製造商規定的 Tmax。
  • 依規定完成 30 個循環。
單一循環溫度與時間程序
IEC 62660-2:2018 表 4－溫度循環的溫度與持續時間

量測與記錄
  • 試驗開始及結束時的電芯電壓與容量；
  • 試驗結束時的電芯狀態，依 IEC 62660-2:2018 第 7 章的狀態描述記錄；
  • 每一循環期間應連續記錄電芯電壓與溫度。
合格判定

6.3.2 Temperature cycling PDF pp. 13-14

6.3.2.1 Purpose

This test is performed to simulate the anticipated exposure to low and high environmental temperature variations which can result in expansion and contraction of cell components, and to verify the safety performance of the cell under such conditions.

6.3.2.2 Test

The test shall be performed in accordance with 6.3.2.2 of IEC 62660-2:2018.

6.3.2.3 Acceptance criteria

During the test, the cell shall exhibit no evidence of leakage, venting, rupture, fire or explosion.

Integrated reference — IEC 62660-2:2018, 6.3.2 Temperature cycling

6.3.2.1 Purpose

This test is performed to characterize thermal durability of a cell by exposing at low and high temperature environment alternately to cause expansion and contraction of cell components.

6.3.2.2 Test

The test shall be performed as follows.

  1. Adjust the SOC of the cell to 100 % for BEV application, and to 80 % for HEV application in accordance with 5.3.
  2. Perform the temperature cycling in accordance with ISO 16750-4 as shown in Table 4. The minimum operating temperature shall be −40 °C or Tmin specified by the cell manufacturer and the maximum operating temperature shall be 85 °C or Tmax specified by the cell manufacturer. Perform 30 test cycles as specified.

6.3.2.3 Test results

6.4 電氣試驗

6.4.1 外部短路 IEC 62660-3：PDF 第 14 頁｜IEC 62660-2：第 15 頁External short-circuit

試驗目的

模擬電芯外部短路，並驗證該條件下的安全性能。

引用方法來源

IEC 62660-3:2022 的 6.4.1.2 規定，本試驗應依 IEC 62660-2:2018 的 6.4.1.2 執行；以下已整合該引用條款的完整試驗條件。

試驗前提

依 5.3 將電芯 SOC 調整至 100 %，並在室溫下存放。

短路條件
  • 以外部電阻連接電芯正、負端子，使電芯短路 10 min。
  • 總外部電阻應由客戶與電芯製造商協議，且應 ≤ 5 mΩ。
資料擷取與記錄

電壓與電流的記錄取樣間隔應 ≤ 10 ms，並量測及記錄：

  • 試驗期間的電芯電壓；
  • 試驗期間的電芯電流；若量測精度偏離 4.3 的要求，應在報告中說明；
  • 試驗期間的電芯溫度；
  • 總外部電阻值；
  • 試驗結束時的電芯狀態，依 IEC 62660-2:2018 第 7 章的狀態描述記錄。
合格判定

依 IEC 62660-3:2022 的 6.4.1.3，試驗期間不得出現起火或爆炸。

顯示英文原文

6.4 Electrical tests

6.4.1 External short-circuit PDF p. 14

6.4.1.1 Purpose

This test is performed to simulate an external short-circuit of a cell, and to verify the safety performance of the cell under such conditions.

6.4.1.2 Test

The test shall be performed in accordance with 6.4.1.2 of IEC 62660-2:2018.

6.4.1.3 Acceptance criteria

During the test, the cell shall exhibit no evidence of fire or explosion.

Integrated reference — IEC 62660-2:2018, 6.4.1 External short circuit

6.4.1.1 Purpose

This test is performed to characterize cell responses to external short circuit.

6.4.1.2 Test

The test shall be performed as follows.

  1. Adjust the SOC of the cell to 100 % in accordance with 5.3.
  2. The cell adjusted as in a) shall be stored at room temperature, and then be short-circuited by connecting the positive and negative terminals with an external resistance for 10 min. The total external resistance shall be equal to or less than 5 mΩ as agreed between the customer and the cell manufacturer.
6.4.1.3 Test results

The following shall be measured and recorded as test results; the sample rate for voltage and current recording shall be ≤ 10 ms:

  • cell voltage during the test;
  • cell current during the test. If the accuracy deviates from the requirements of 4.3, it shall be reported;
  • cell temperature during the test;
  • total external resistance value;
  • condition of the cell at the end of the test in accordance with the description specified in Clause 7.

6.4.2 過充電 PDF 第 14 頁Overcharge

試驗目的

模擬電芯過充電並驗證該條件下的安全性能。

試驗前提

依 5.3 將電芯 SOC 調整至 100 %。

充電條件

在室溫下，使用足以維持定電流的電源，於 100 % SOC 之後持續充電：

  • BEV：1 It 或 1/3 It
  • HEV：5 It 或 1 It
停止條件

下列任一條件先發生時停止試驗：

  • 電芯電壓達到或超過製造商規定最大電壓的 120 %；
  • 施加至電芯的電量達到或超過等效 130 % SOC。
協議彈性

試驗條件可依電芯製造商與客戶協議決定。

合格判定

試驗期間不得出現起火或爆炸。

顯示英文原文

6.4.2 Overcharge PDF p. 14

6.4.2.1 Purpose

This test is performed to simulate an overcharge of a cell, and to verify the safety performance of the cell under such conditions.

6.4.2.2 Test

The test shall be performed as follows:

  1. Adjust the SOC of the cell to 100 % in accordance with 5.3;
  2. Continue charging the cell beyond the 100 % SOC with a charging current 1 It or 1/3 It for BEV application and 5 It or 1 It for HEV application at room temperature using a power supply sufficient to provide the constant charging current. The overcharge test shall be discontinued when the voltage of the cell reaches or exceeds 120 % of the maximum voltage specified by the cell manufacturer, or the quantity of electricity applied to the cell reaches or exceeds the equivalent of 130 % SOC, whichever comes first.
  3. The test conditions may be according to the agreement between the cell manufacturer and the customer.
6.4.2.3 Acceptance criteria

During the test, the cell shall exhibit no evidence of fire or explosion.

6.4.3 強制放電 PDF 第 14～15 頁Forced discharge

試驗目的

模擬電芯過度放電並驗證該條件下的安全性能。

試驗前提

依 5.3 將電芯 SOC 調整至 0 %。

試驗條件

在室溫下，以 1 It 放電電流持續放電至 0 % SOC 以下。

停止條件

下列任一條件先發生時停止試驗：

  • 電芯電壓絕對值降至製造商規定標稱電壓的 25 % 以下；
  • 放電時間達 30 min。
合格判定

試驗期間不得出現漏液、洩壓、破裂、起火或爆炸。

顯示英文原文

6.4.3 Forced discharge PDF pp. 14-15

6.4.3.1 Purpose

This test is performed to simulate an overdischarge of a cell, and to verify the safety performance of the cell under such conditions.

6.4.3.2 Test

The test shall be performed as follows:

  1. Adjust the SOC of the cell to 0 % in accordance with 5.3;
  2. Continue discharging the cell beyond the 0 % SOC with a 1 It discharging current at room temperature. The forced discharge test shall be discontinued when the absolute value of the voltage of the cell reaches 25 % or less of the nominal voltage specified by the cell manufacturer, or the cell is discharged for 30 min, whichever occurs sooner.
6.4.3.3 Acceptance criteria

During the test, the cell shall exhibit no evidence of leakage, venting, rupture, fire or explosion.

6.4.4 內部短路試驗 PDF 第 15～16 頁Internal short-circuit test

試驗目的

模擬導電異物污染等原因造成的電芯內部短路，並驗證該條件下的安全性能。

註：附錄 B 提供內部短路試驗的說明。

6.4.4.2.1 強制內部短路試驗

除下列例外外，應依 IEC 62619 的 7.3.2 b) 對電芯執行試驗。

  • 鎳粒子置於正極活性物質塗佈區與負極活性物質塗佈區之間時，應確認形成單層內部短路。
  • 如為模擬單層內部短路所必要，可修改加壓力、治具形狀等試驗條件；但不得壓潰電芯外殼及電極，且任何修改均應記錄於報告。
  • 可透過電芯外殼切口插入鎳粒子，而不將電極芯體（捲繞、疊片或折疊型）自外殼取出。只要不影響結果，鎳粒子位置可不位於電芯中心。

註：單層內部短路通常以數 mV 的電壓下降表示。

若正極鋁箔在最外圈裸露並面對負極活性物質，鎳粒子應置於電芯中心，位於負極活性物質塗佈區與正極活性物質塗佈區在捲繞方向末端的正極鋁箔之間。其他正極鋁箔面對負極活性物質的區域，可依製造商與客戶協議，透過設計審查、失效模式與效應分析（FMEA）等方式確認。

外部標準引用：強制內部短路的基礎程序需搭配 IEC 62619；本條僅規定例外與補充條件。
6.4.4.2.2 替代內部短路試驗

經電芯製造商與客戶協議，可執行附錄 C 的內部短路試驗，以取代 6.4.4.2.1 的強制內部短路試驗。

合格判定

試驗期間不得出現起火或爆炸。

顯示英文原文

6.4.4 Internal short-circuit test PDF pp. 15-16

6.4.4.1 Purpose

This test is performed to simulate an internal short-circuit of a cell which is caused by its contamination with a conductive particle, etc., and to verify the safety performance of the cell under such conditions.

NOTE Annex B provides the informative explanation on the internal short-circuit test.

6.4.4.2 Test
6.4.4.2.1 Forced internal short-circuit test

The test shall be performed on the cell in accordance with 7.3.2 b) of IEC 62619, except as follows.

When the nickel particle is placed between the positive active material coated area and the negative active material coated area, the internal short-circuit of single layer shall be confirmed. The specified test conditions, such as the pressing force and the shape of jig, may be modified, if necessary in order to simulate the internal short-circuit of single layer. The case and electrodes of the cell shall not be crushed. Any modification shall be reported.

The nickel particle may be inserted through an incision in the cell case, without extracting the electrode core (winding, stacking or folding type) from the cell case. In such a case, the position of the nickel particle may not be the centre of cell, to the extent that the test result is not influenced.

NOTE The internal short-circuit of a single layer is usually indicated by a voltage drop of a few mV.

In cases where the aluminium foil of positive electrode is exposed at the outer turn, and that it faces the negative active material, the nickel particle is placed at the centre of the cell between the negative active material coated area and the positive aluminium foil which is at the end of the positive active material coated area in the winding direction. The other area where the positive aluminium foil faces the negative active material, if any, may be checked by the design review, failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA), etc. according to the agreement between the cell manufacturer and the customer.

6.4.4.2.2 Alternative internal short-circuit test

If agreed between the cell manufacturer and the customer, the internal short-circuit test in Annex C may be conducted as an alternative to the forced internal short-circuit test in 6.4.4.2.1.

6.4.4.3 Acceptance criteria

During the test, the cell shall exhibit no evidence of fire or explosion.

安全使用的電芯操作區域Operating region of cells for safe use Operating region of cells for safe use

附錄 A資料性附錄｜Annex A (informative)

A.1 一般說明 PDF 第 17 頁General

本附錄說明如何決定電芯的操作區域，以確保安全使用。操作區域由充電上限電壓及電芯溫度等充電條件所界定。

電芯製造商宜在電芯規格中明定操作區域，作為提供電池包及系統製造商等客戶之安全注意事項。電池控制系統亦宜具備適當的保護裝置與功能，以因應充電控制可能失效的情況。

操作區域的邊界係基於最低安全要求，與為最佳化循環壽命等性能而規定的充電電壓及溫度不同。

顯示英文原文

A.1 General PDF p. 17

This annex explains how to determine the operating region of the cell to ensure the safe use of the cell. The operating region is specified by the charging conditions such as the upper limit of charging voltage and cell temperature, which ensure the safety of cells.

The cell manufacturers should stipulate the information on the operating region in the specification of the cell, as part of the guidance on safety precautions to be provided to their customers, such as the manufacturers of battery packs and systems. A suitable protection device and function should also be provided in the battery control system, for possible failure of the charge control.

The limits of the operating region are specified for the minimum safety and are different from the charging voltage and temperature specified to optimize the performance of the cell (such as cycle life).

A.2 安全使用的充電條件 PDF 第 17～18 頁Charging conditions for safe use

A.2.1 一般要求

為確保電芯安全使用，製造商宜設定充電期間適用的電壓上限及電芯溫度範圍。電芯宜在預先界定的標準溫度範圍內，以不超過充電上限電壓的條件充電。

製造商亦可設定高於或低於標準溫度範圍的區域，但應採取降低充電電壓等安全措施。操作區域係指電芯可安全使用的電壓與溫度範圍；亦可設定最大充電電流及放電下限電壓。

若新開發電芯與原電芯具有相同電極材料、厚度、設計及隔離部件，且容量低於原電芯的 120 %，可採用與原電芯相同的操作區域，並視為同一產品系列電芯。

A.2.2 充電電壓考量

充電電壓用以促進充電反應；若電壓過高，會發生過度化學反應或副反應，使電芯熱穩定性降低。因此充電電壓不得超過製造商規定的充電上限電壓。

當電芯以高於上限的電壓充電時，正極活性物質會過量脫嵌鋰離子，晶體結構傾向崩解。此時一旦發生內部短路，相較於在預定操作區域內充電的電芯，更容易觸發熱失控。因此電芯不應在高於充電上限電壓的條件充電。

製造商宜依驗證試驗設定充電上限電壓，並提出例如下列結果：

  • 確認正極材料晶體結構穩定性的試驗結果；
  • 確認電芯充至上限電壓時，負極活性物質仍可接受鋰離子的試驗結果；
  • 確認充至上限電壓的電芯，在標準溫度範圍上限依第 6 章進行安全試驗，且各項試驗均符合合格判定的結果。

A.2.3 溫度考量

A.2.3.1 一般

充電涉及化學反應並受溫度影響。充電副反應數量及反應產物狀態與溫度相關。在低溫或高溫區充電，相較於可安全使用充電上限電壓的標準溫度區，通常會產生更多副反應，安全風險也更高。因此在低溫及高溫區，宜降低充電電壓及／或充電電流，使其低於充電上限電壓及／或最大充電電流。

A.2.3.2 高溫區

電芯在高於標準溫度範圍的溫度充電時，因晶體結構穩定性下降，安全性能傾向降低；高溫區內亦可能因相對較小的溫度變化而觸發熱失控。

高溫區充電宜依下列方式控制：

  • 電芯表面溫度位於製造商規定的高溫區內時，採用較低充電電壓與電流等特定充電條件；
  • 電芯表面溫度高於高溫區上限時，不得以任何充電電流充電。
A.2.3.3 低溫區

在低溫區充電時，質傳速率下降，鋰離子嵌入負極材料的速率降低，使金屬鋰容易沉積於碳材料表面。此時電芯熱穩定性降低，容易過熱並引發熱失控。

此外，低溫下鋰離子接受能力高度依賴溫度。多顆串聯的鋰電池系統中，各電芯因溫度不同而具有不同的鋰離子接受能力，進而降低系統安全性。

低溫區充電宜依下列方式控制：

  • 電芯表面溫度位於製造商規定的低溫區內時，採用較低充電電壓與電流等特定充電條件；
  • 電芯表面溫度低於低溫區下限時，不得以任何充電電流充電。
顯示英文原文

A.2 Charging conditions for safe use PDF pp. 17-18

A.2.1 General

In order to ensure the safe use of cells, the cell manufacturers should set the upper limit of the voltage and the temperature of cell to be applied during charging. The cell should be charged within a predefined temperature range (standard temperature range) at the voltage not exceeding the upper limit. The cell manufacturer may also set a temperature range higher or lower than the standard temperature range, provided that the safety measures, such as lowered charging voltage, are taken. The operating region means such range of voltage and temperature where the cell can be used safely. The maximum charging current and the lower limit of the discharging voltage may also be set for the operating region.

A newly developed cell can apply the same operating region as the original cell, if it has the same electrode material, thickness, design, and separator as the original cell, and less than 120 % of the capacity of the original cell. The new cell can be considered as the same product series cell.

A.2.2 Consideration on charging voltage

The charging voltage is applied for cells so as to promote the chemical reaction during charging. However, if the charging voltage is too high, excessive chemical reactions or side reactions occur, and the cell becomes thermally unstable. Consequently, it is essential that the charging voltage never exceeds the value specified by the cell manufacturer (i.e. the upper limit of charging voltage). When a cell is charged at a higher voltage than the upper limit charging voltage, excess amount of lithium-ion is deintercalated from the positive electrode active material, and its crystalline structure tends to collapse. In these conditions, when an internal short-circuit occurs, thermal runaway can occur more easily than it does for cells charged in the predefined operating region. Consequently, the cells should never be charged at a higher voltage than the upper limit charging voltage.

The upper limit charging voltage should be set by the cell manufacturer based on the verification tests, and showing the results, for example, as follows:

  • test results which verify the stability of the crystalline structure of the positive material;
  • test results which verify the acceptance of lithium-ion into the negative active electrode material when the cell is charged at the upper limit charging voltage;
  • test results which verify that the cells charged at the upper limit charging voltage are tested in accordance with the safety test in Clause 6 at the upper limit of the standard temperature range, and the acceptance criteria of each test are met.

A.2.3 Consideration on temperature

A.2.3.1 General

Charging produces a chemical reaction and is affected by temperature. The number of side reactions or the condition of the reaction products during charging is dependent on temperature. Charging in the low or high temperature range is considered to cause more side reactions, and is a more severe risk from a safety viewpoint than when it is done in the standard temperature range where the upper limit charging voltage is safely applicable. Consequently, the charging voltage and/or the charging current should be reduced from the upper limit charging voltage and/or the maximum charging current in both the low temperature range and the high temperature range.

A.2.3.2 High temperature range

When a cell is charged at a higher temperature than the standard temperature range, the safety performance of the cell tends to decrease due to lower stability of the crystalline structure. Also, in the high temperature range, the thermal runaway tends to occur following a relatively small change in temperature.

As a result, the charging of cells in the high temperature range should be controlled as follows:

  • when the surface temperature of the cell is within the high temperature range specified by the cell manufacturer, specific charging conditions, such as lower charging voltage and current, are applied;
  • when the surface temperature of the cell is higher than the upper limit of the high temperature range, the cell shall never be charged under any charging current.
A.2.3.3 Low temperature range

When a cell is charged in the low temperature range, the mass transfer rate decreases and the lithium-ion insertion rate into the negative material becomes low. Consequently, metallic lithium is easily deposited on the carbon surface. In this condition, the cell becomes thermally unstable and liable to become overheated and to cause the thermal runaway. Also, in the low temperature range, the acceptance of lithium-ions is highly dependent on the temperature. In a lithium battery system that consists of multi-cells in a series connection, the lithium-ion acceptability of each cell differs depending on the cell temperature, which reduces the safety of the battery system.

As a result, the charging of cells in the low temperature range should be controlled as follows:

  • when the surface temperature of the cell is within the low temperature range specified by the cell manufacturer, specific charging conditions, such as lower charging voltage and current, are applied;
  • when the surface temperature of the cell is below the lower limit of the lower temperature range, the cell shall never be charged under any charging current.

A.3 操作區域示例 PDF 第 19 頁Example of operating region

圖 A.1 為典型充電操作區域示例。在高於或低於標準溫度區的範圍內，只要降低充電電壓及／或電流，仍可允許充電。操作區域可採圖示的階梯形邊界，也可採斜線邊界。圖 A.2 為放電操作區域示例。

顯示英文原文

A.3 Example of operating region PDF p. 19

Figure A.1 illustrates a typical example of an operating region for charging. In a temperature range higher or lower than the standard temperature range, it is permissible to charge the cell provided that a lower charging voltage and/or current are used. The operating range can be specified with a step shape which is shown in Figure A.1, or with diagonal lines. Figure A.2 illustrates an example of an operating region for discharging.

內部短路試驗說明Explanation for the internal short-circuit test Explanation for the internal short-circuit test

附錄 B資料性附錄｜Annex B (informative)

B.1 一般概念 PDF 第 20 頁General concept

本文件的內部短路試驗用於驗證電芯在特定內部短路情境下的行為。依 6.4.4.2.1 執行的內部短路試驗，可證明電芯在內部存在異物時，仍能避免起火或爆炸，代表針對該特定情境的風險降低能力。

然而，任何內部短路試驗都不能證明電芯熱失控的可能性已降為零。因此，單顆電芯熱失控的風險仍應在向上整合至電芯組、模組、電池包及車輛等系統層級時加以緩解。為確保鋰離子技術在車輛上的安全使用，風險降低責任需由電芯至整車的各結構層級共同承擔。

顯示英文原文

B.1 General concept PDF p. 20

The internal short-circuit tests in this document verify the cell behaviour in some specific cases of the internal short-circuit. The internal short-circuit test according to 6.4.4.2.1 demonstrates the ability of the cell to withstand the presence of a particle in the cell without fire or explosion. It represents the demonstration of the risk mitigation linked to that particular case.

None of the internal short-circuit tests, however, demonstrates that the possibility of thermal runaway in the cell is reduced to zero. Accordingly, the risk linked to the thermal runaway of one cell should be mitigated in the scale-up level leading to the overall system (cell block, module, battery pack or vehicle). It is important to note that the comprehensive mitigation of the risk needs to be shared between the various levels of the structure from the cell to the vehicle in order to ensure the safe use of lithium-ion technology in vehicles.

B.2 導電異物污染造成的內部短路 PDF 第 20～21 頁Internal short-circuit caused by particle contamination

從製造過程到車輛使用階段，電芯內部短路可能有多種成因。本文件的各項安全試驗用於驗證電芯面對不同短路成因時的基本安全性，見表 B.1。

6.4.4 的內部短路試驗特別用於模擬製造過程中可能發生的導電異物污染。異物污染尤其關鍵，因市場上可攜式鋰離子電池的部分起火事件被認為與異物污染有關。

查看原始英文表格截圖

6.4.4.2.1 引用 IEC 62619 所規定的強制內部短路（FISC）試驗；FISC 的詳細程序亦定義於 IEC 62133-2。試驗在電芯中插入鎳粒子，以模擬內部短路的最嚴苛情境。

規定尺寸的鎳粒子代表電芯內可能存在的最大異物，並在電極間產生最大熱量。異物污染造成正、負極之間一至兩層的內部短路，可由 6.4.4.2 的短路試驗模擬。經處理試驗電芯的熱、化學及電氣條件應與未處理電芯等效，且不得影響試驗結果。

註 1：因試驗電芯所用聚乙烯袋的導熱性低，經處理電芯的熱條件與未處理電芯相當或更嚴苛。壓製治具採壓克力樹脂或丁腈橡膠，導熱性低，不會影響電芯散熱及短路區域的快速發熱。

註 2：依規定程序準備電芯時，電解液蒸發幾乎可完全避免，因此不影響試驗結果。就容量與電阻而言，經處理電芯的性能與未處理狀態幾乎相同。

顯示英文原文

B.2 Internal short-circuit caused by the particle contamination PDF pp. 20-21

The internal short-circuit of the cell is likely to have various causes from the production process through to the use in the vehicle. The different safety tests in this document are intended to verify the basic safety of the cell against the various short-circuit causes (see Table B.1).

The internal short-circuit test in 6.4.4 is specially intended to simulate the contamination of a cell by a conductive particle, which potentially occurs during the manufacturing process. Particle contamination is especially critical, because the fire incidents of the portable lithium-ion batteries on the market are attributed in part to particle contamination.

The test in 6.4.4.2.1 refers to the forced internal short-circuit (FISC) test as specified in IEC 62619. The detailed procedure of the FISC test is also defined in IEC 62133-2. The FISC test is conducted with a test cell in which a nickel particle is inserted, and to simulate the worst-case condition of the internal short-circuit. The specified size of the nickel particle represents the largest contaminant potentially contained in a cell, and generates the maximum heat between the electrodes. The particle contamination causes a one- to two-layer internal short-circuit between the positive electrode and the negative electrode, which can be simulated by the short-circuit test in 6.4.4.2. It is verified that the thermal, chemical and electrical conditions of the processed test cell are equivalent to those of the unprocessed cell, and have no influence on the test result.

NOTE 1 The thermal condition of the processed test cell is equivalent to or more severe than that of the unprocessed cell, because of the small heat conductance of the polyethylene bag to be used for the test cell. The press jig made of acrylic resin or nitrile rubber has small heat conductance, and does not affect the heat release from the test cell and the rapid heat generation at the short-circuited area.

NOTE 2 The evaporation of electrolyte during the preparation of the test cell is almost entirely prevented according to the specified test procedure, so that there is no influence on the test result. The processed cell has almost the same performance as it has in its unprocessed state in terms of both capacity and resistance.

替代內部短路試驗（6.4.4.2.2）Alternative internal short-circuit test (6.4.4.2.2) Alternative internal short-circuit test (6.4.4.2.2)

顯示英文原文

C.1 General PDF p. 22

This annex provides the test specifications for the alternative internal short-circuit test set out in 6.4.4.2.2.

This test is applicable to prismatic and pouch cells.

The test shall be made with 5 cells. The number of cells may be changed according to the agreement between the cell manufacturer and the customer.

C.2 試驗準備與配置Test preparation and test set-up

C.2.1 試驗前電芯準備 PDF 第 22～23 頁

  • 對方形硬殼電芯，如為避免外殼變形影響內部短路事件，可視需要依製造商建議的適當方法將外殼減薄或移除。
  • 若方形硬殼電芯的外殼與正極或負極任一側電氣連接，應依製造商建議的適當方法移除外殼。
  • 軟包電芯外殼不得減薄或移除。
  • 外殼減薄或移除宜在電芯充電及電壓調整前進行，並採取所有必要安全措施。

建議的硬殼局部移除方法如下：

  1. 步驟 1：將電芯外殼表面局部減薄至剩餘約外殼厚度的 10 %，亦即切削深度達外殼厚度的 90 %。減薄工具的切削刃應設計為可進入外殼厚度的 90 %。除簡易手動工具外，亦可使用銑床或其他工具。
  1. 步驟 2：在移除銷的黏接面塗膠，並將移除銷黏接於外殼減薄處。黏接面尺寸應與減薄孔尺寸相同。建議使用拉伸強度高於 20 MPa 的膠材，例如熱熔膠或環氧樹脂。膠固化後拉出移除銷；試驗前，移除後的孔洞宜以絕緣膠帶封閉。

亦可在電芯製造過程中預先設計硬殼移除區：

  1. 步驟 1：例如在製造時額外焊接洩壓片，形成弱化區。
  2. 步驟 2：以 1:1 比例混合 AB 膠，將拉片黏接於洩壓片，等待 10 min 確保膠材固化後，以拉片移除洩壓片。

C.2.2 試驗配置 PDF 第 24～25 頁

C.2.2.1 電芯固定

應使用固定裝置防止電芯在試驗期間移動，且電芯應與試驗台電氣絕緣。

C.2.2.2 電壓量測

為偵測目標內部短路，應依電芯設計量測電芯負極或正極端子與壓入針之間的電壓。電壓量測線不得接至最外層電極的端子。

C.2.2.3 壓入針裝置
  • 壓入針應為鋼或不鏽鋼釘，例如 SKD-11、SUS 440C 或 SUS 300 系列。
  • 直徑：1 mm～3 mm。
  • 針尖角度宜為 20°～45°。

C.2.3 初步試驗 PDF 第 25 頁

正式試驗前，應先決定對應於受試電芯一至兩層短路的壓入停止條件，即電壓下降值：

  1. 適用時依 C.2.1 準備電芯。
  2. 將電芯電壓調整至充電上限電壓。
  3. 依 C.2.2 固定電芯。壓入針應垂直於電極層；電芯或壓入針沿此垂直軸移動，壓入位置與 6.4.4.2.1 相同。
  4. 試驗溫度為 25 °C ± 5 K；電壓取樣率應 ≥ 1 000 Hz。
  5. 以 0.01 mm/s 定速將壓入針壓入電芯，或將電芯推向壓入針。若能形成一至兩層內部短路，可使用更快速度。當壓入針與端子間電壓達到正、負端子間電壓後，若偵測到明顯突降電壓，宜停止加壓；停止後應於 10 s 內將壓入針退出電芯。
  1. 將電芯放電至安全電壓後拆解，確認短路層數。重複步驟 a)～e)，直到形成一至兩層內部短路並決定停止壓入的電壓下降參數。短路層數等於正、負極間短路點的數量；壓入針未接觸處的短路點不計入。
顯示英文原文

C.2 Test preparation and test set-up

C.2.1 Preparation of cell before the test PDF pp. 22-23

For a prismatic cell, the case may be thinned or removed by an appropriate method recommended by the cell manufacturer, if necessary, in order to avoid the effect of case deformation on the internal short-circuit event.

For a prismatic cell with the case connected to either the positive electrode or negative electrode, the case shall be removed by an appropriate method recommended by the cell manufacturer.

The case of a pouch cell shall not be thinned or removed.

Thinning or removal of the case should be conducted before charging and the voltage adjustment of the cell. This operation should be conducted taking all the safety measures needed.

The following is a recommended method of removing a piece of the hard case for the indenter press.

  1. Step 1 - Thin the surface of the cell case partially up to 90 % of the case thickness. Figure C.1 shows an example of case thinning. The thinning tool shall be designed in order that the edge of cutting head enters into 90 % of the case thickness. Figure C.2 shows an example of a simplified manual thinning tool. A milling machine or other tools can also be used.
  1. Step 2 - Apply glue to the attachment surface of a removal pin, then attach the removal pin to the thinned part of case. The attachment surface of the removal pin shall be the same size as the thinned case hole. Glue of tensile strength above 20 MPa is recommended (for example, glue gun or epoxy glue). After glue hardening, pull the removal pin out. The hole of removed part should be sealed with insulation tape before the test. Figure C.3 shows an example of the case removal process.

Figure C.4 also shows an example of hard case removal during the cell manufacturing process as follows:

  1. Step 1 - Prepare the weak area for example by welding an additional vent during the cell manufacturing process.
  2. Step 2 - Mix the AB glue using a ratio of (1:1). Bond the pull-tab with glue on the vent piece, and wait for 10 min to ensure the glue has cured. Use the pull-tab to remove the vent piece.

C.2.2 Test setup PDF p. 24

C.2.2.1 Fixation of cell

The cell shall be held in a manner to prevent movement during the test using a fixation device. The cell shall be electrically isolated from the test bench. Figure C.5 shows an example of a fixation device.

C.2.2.2 Voltage measurement

In order to detect the targeted internal short-circuit, the voltage shall be measured between the negative or positive terminal of the cell and an indenter according to the cell design. The voltage line shall not be connected to a terminal of the outermost electrode. Figure C.6 shows an image of the test setup.

C.2.2.3 Indenter device PDF p. 25

The indenter shall be a steel or SUS nail, for example, SKD-11, SUS 440C, SUS 300 series, having a diameter of between 1 mm and 3 mm.

The angle of the nail tip should be between 20° and 45°.

C.2.3 Preliminary test PDF p. 25

The condition of the indenter stop, i.e. the value of the voltage drop, which corresponds to a one- or two-layer short-circuit of the cell under test, shall be determined before the test as follows:

  1. Prepare the cell in accordance with C.2.1, if applicable.
  2. Adjust the voltage of the cell to the upper limit charging voltage.
  3. Fix the cell to the test setup in accordance with C.2.2. The indenter shall be placed perpendicular to the electrode layers of the cell. The cell or the indenter shall move along this perpendicular axis. The indentation location shall be the same as that described in 6.4.4.2.1.
  4. The preliminary test shall be conducted at the test temperature of 25 °C ± 5 K. During the test, the voltage shall be recorded with sampling rate of 1 000 Hz or more.
  5. Press the indenter to the cell, or press the cell up to the indenter, with a constant velocity of 0,01 mm/s. The press speed may be faster than 0,01 mm/s if a one- to two-layer internal short-circuit can be achieved. The press should be stopped when a visible abrupt voltage drop is detected after the voltage between the indenter and the terminal reaches the voltage between negative and positive terminals. After the stop of the press, release the indenter from the cell within 10 s. Figure C.7 shows an example of the voltage drop.
  1. Discharge the cell to a safety voltage, and then disassemble the cell to check the number of shorted layer. Repeat steps a) to e) until a one- to two-layer internal short-circuit is achieved, and the voltage drop parameter for the indenter stop is determined. The number of short-circuit layers is equal to the number of shorted points between the positive and negative electrode. The shorted point where the indenter did not touch is not counted as shorted layer.

C.3 試驗程序 PDF 第 26 頁Test procedure

  1. 適用時依 C.2.1 準備電芯。
  2. 將電芯電壓調整至充電上限電壓。
  3. 依 C.2.2 固定電芯。壓入針應垂直於電極層；電芯或壓入針沿此垂直軸移動，壓入位置與 6.4.4.2.1 相同。
  4. 試驗溫度為 25 °C ± 5 K。電壓取樣率應 ≥ 1 000 Hz；電芯溫度可使用 ≥ 1 Hz 的取樣率記錄。溫度感測器宜設於電芯表面，距壓入中心小於 25 mm。

註：停止加壓後，量測頻率可高於 1 Hz。

  1. 以 0.01 mm/s 定速將壓入針壓入電芯，或將電芯推向壓入針。若能形成一至兩層內部短路，可使用更快速度。偵測到 C.2.3 所決定的電壓下降時，應立即停止加壓。
  2. 停止加壓後，電芯應觀察 1 h。壓入針應維持於停止位置，直到包含觀察期間在內的試驗結束；X、Y、Z 三方向位置穩定度應保持在 ±0.02 mm 以內。

註：觀察期結束後，可拆解電芯確認短路層數。

C.4 合格判定Acceptance criteria

依 6.4.4.3：試驗期間不得出現起火或爆炸。

顯示英文原文

C.3 Test procedure PDF p. 26

The test shall be conducted as follows:

  1. Prepare the cell in accordance with C.2.1, if applicable.
  2. Adjust the voltage of the cell to the upper limit charging voltage.
  3. Fix the cell to the test setup in accordance with C.2.2. The indenter shall be placed perpendicular to the electrode layers of the cell. The cell or the indenter shall move along this perpendicular axis. The indentation location shall be the same as described in 6.4.4.2.1.
  4. The test shall be conducted at the test temperature of 25 °C ± 5 K. During the test, the voltage shall be recorded with a sampling rate of 1 000 Hz or more. The temperature of the cell may be recorded with a sampling rate of 1 Hz or more. The temperature measuring device should be set on the surface of the cell, at a distance of less than 25 mm from the centre of the indentation.

NOTE After the press is stopped, the measuring frequency can be more than 1 Hz.

  1. Press the indenter to the cell, or press the cell up to the indenter, with a constant velocity of 0,01 mm/s. The press speed may be faster than 0,01 mm/s if a one- to two-layer internal short-circuit can be achieved. The press shall be stopped immediately when the voltage drop as determined in C.2.3 is detected.
  2. After stopping the press, the cell shall be observed for 1 h. The indenter shall remain in place at the stop, and be kept stable within ± 0,02 mm in the X, Y and Z directions until the end of the test including the observation period.

NOTE After the end of the observation period, the cell can be disassembled to check the number of shorted layers.

C.4 Acceptance criteria

See 6.4.4.3.
